title: Orange-Cardamom Pancakes
changes_from_base: Ground cardamom and orange zest flavour a milk batter that is beaten smooth; the source uses orange extract, which I replaced with a second tablespoon of zest.
summary: Fragrant pancakes brightened with orange zest and warmed with cardamom, best served with maple syrup.
equipment: large nonstick frying pan or griddle

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
butter, melted, plus more for the pan and to serve

steps.title: Whisk Dry
steps.text: Whisk 256 g plain flour, 2 tbsp caster sugar, 2½ tsp baking powder, 2 tsp cardamom and ¼ tsp salt.

steps.title: Whisk Wet
steps.text: Whisk 360 ml milk, 2 eggs, 2 tbsp grated orange zest and 42 g melted butter.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Stir the wet mix into the dry with a spoon or spatula, then beat with a whisk or hand mixer on high until smooth, about 30 s.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Heat a large non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat, add butter and tilt to coat, then cook in batches using about 80 ml batter each until bubbly on top and golden underneath, 1-2 min.

steps.title: Flip
steps.text: Flip and cook until golden, a further 1-2 min, adjusting the heat and adding more butter as needed between batches.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with maple syrup and butter.

tips: Beat the batter until smooth after mixing - it helps the pancakes rise evenly.
Grate the zest finely so it distributes through the batter rather than clumping.
Keep the heat at medium so the pancakes turn golden without the zest catching.
storage: Best eaten fresh and warm, straight from the pan. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
